definition: Post-hoc optimisation test: evidence-confirmation gate on the rule-layer classifier. flag' = fired rule ∧ ≥1 linked evidence chunk of level A/B/C for that rule. Gold: three-state, positive = replicated. Per-seed over five seeds; source canonical jsonl + evidence_chunks linked_rules.
verdict: Gate raises internal specificity/PPV/kappa at unchanged sensitivity (consistent with pre-registered G1/G2 ablation 0.455->0.476->0.500 on judgeable pairs); externally it trades one TP for one FP (kappa slightly down). Severity tiers are weak discriminators. Recommended deployable classifier remains G2 (rule + negative-control gate + evidence confirmation + arbiter); coverage-aware abstention recommended so uncovered pairs are declared 'no rule', not silent negatives.
